A Classic 1950s Themed American Diner
With our retro newspaper menus, collector cars, hand-spun milkshakes, classic diner cuisine and breakfast all-day, The Sunliner Diner is sure to become your favorite spot to hang out- It’s Guaranteed!  Take a blast to the past with your family and friends, come and see what all the buzz is about- the fun never ends! Visit our Gift Shop to bring your memories of a swell time home with you!

Delicious Waffles. Breakfast All Day. Mouthwatering Milkshakes.Your vacation destination.
The Sunliner Diner, with three remarkable locations, beautiful Gulf Shores, Alabama,  Orange Beach, Alabama, and Pigeon Forge, TN, is turning back the hands of time to the 1950s! Located just walking distance to the beautiful white sands of Gulf Shores. The Fantastic family fun of Pigeon Forge and the spectacular sunsets of Orange Beach – The Sunliner Diner is the quintessential symbol of American culture, where family and friends can connect over hamburgers, all-day breakfast and milkshakes. Come and have a seat, enjoy a tasty treat- and throw some quarters in the jukebox. Visit our Gift Shop to take your memories of a swell time home with you!

 BREAKFAST 
 
 
 SERVED ALL DAY
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 EGGS–BENEDICT* 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 SHRIMP BENEDICT 
 
 
 Two poached eggs, Creole seasoned Gulf shrimp, sliced red tomato
covered with Creole hollandaise sauce on top of a Sunliner biscuit.
Served with hash browns or grits.
 
 
 
 

 
 CLASSIC BENEDICT 
 
 
 Two poached eggs with Creole hollandaise sauce, smoked ham on top
of an English muffin. Served with hash browns or grits.
 
 
 
 

 
 CHICKEN & WAFFLE BENEDICT 
 
 
 Belgian waffle, hand-battered fried boneless chicken breast, two
poached eggs covered with Creole hollandaise sauce. Topped with
chopped bell peppers, drizzled with syrup. Served with hash browns or grits.
 
 
 
 

 
 AVOCADO BENEDICT 
 
 
 Two poached eggs, fresh avocado, and sliced red tomato covered
with Creole hollandaise sauce on top of a Sunliner biscuit. Topped with chopped bell peppers and served with hash browns or grits.
Add to Beyond Plant-Based Patty.
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 THE SUNLINER GRIDDLE 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 BANANA NUT FRENCH TOAST 
 
 
 Texas toast soaked in a sweet custard topped with fresh bananas, candied pecans, two layers of candied bacon, and drizzled with caramel sauce.
 
 
 
 

 
 CHOCOLATE CHIP PANCAKES 
 
 
 Three light and fluffy buttermilk pancakes filled with chocolate chip morsels.
 
 
 
 

 
 BUTTERMILK PANCAKES 
 
 
 Three light and fluffy buttermilk pancakes.
 
 
 
 

 
 SUNLINER FRENCH TOAST 
 
 
 Texas toast soaked in homemade sweet custard, topped with caramel sauce and powdered sugar.
 
 
 
 

 
 SEASONAL SPECIALTY PANCAKES 
 
 
 Three light and fluffy buttermilk pancakes with your choice of fresh bananas, blueberries, or strawberries on top.
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 WAFFLES 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 DREAM BOAT 
 
 
 Your sweet and salty fantasy. Three giant waffles, bacon, sausage, caramel sauce, chocolate sauce, and whipped cream. Topped with chocolate chips and chopped bacon. Making dreams come true!
 
 
 
 

 
 BERRY STACK 
 
 
 One blueberry waffle and one strawberry waffle topped with blueberries, strawberries, and drizzled with honey. It’s berry delicious!
 
 
 
 

 
 BELGIAN WAFFLES 
 
 
 Two fluffy, delicious house-made waffles.
 
 
 
 

 
 FLAVORED BELGIAN WAFFLES 
 
 
 Your choice of two strawberry or blueberry waffles with any of the following toppings: strawberry, blueberry, or chocolate chips.

When you choose to pay with cash, you automatically enjoy this discount-no extra steps needed!

Drizzled with our Creole hollandaise on a buttered brioche bun. Order it and you can play any song you’d like on the jukebox! Finish it and get a Sunliner surprise!

 A stack of two griddled burger patties, bacon, and cheddar cheese on a buttered brioche bun.

 SUNLINER BUFFALO CHICKEN SANDWICH 
 
 
 Hand-breaded fried chicken breast tossed in our signature sauce topped with lettuce, tomato, and pickles on a brioche bun.
 
 
 
 

 
 GRILLED CHICKEN SANDWICH

 Our famous cheese grits topped with our house-made Creole Conecuh sausage cream sauce, and grilled Gulf shrimp with a bread.
 
 
 
 

 
 CHICKEN TENDER BASKET 
 
 
 Golden fried, hand-breaded chicken tenders and french fries.
 
 
 
 

 
 SUNLINER MEATLOAF 
 
 
 Homemade meatloaf made with bacon bits served with green beans and mashed potatoes with gravy.
 
 
 
 

 
 COUNTRY FRIED STEAK 
 
 
 Country fried beef steak topped with house-made white gravy. Served with green beans and mashed potatoes with gravy.
 
 
 
 

 
 COUNTRY FRIED CHICKEN 
 
 
 Country fried chicken breast topped with house-made white gravy. Served with green beans and mashed potatoes with gravy.
 
 
 
 

 
 NEW YORK STRIP STEAK DINNER 
 
 
 10 oz New York Strip cooked to your liking, served with mashed potatoes and green beans. Add Gulf shrimp.

 Hand-breaded fried Gulf shrimp served with a side of french fries, cole slaw, and cocktail sauce.

 BANANA SPLIT SHAKE 
 
 
 Classic banana split transformed! Banana and pineapple blended into strawberry ice cream topped with chocolate syrup, chopped peanuts, banana, whipped cream, and a cherry on top!
 
 
 
 

 
 PEANUT BUTTER CUP

 Vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry ice cream between a split banana, covered with hot fudge, strawberry sauce, and crushed pineapple. Topped with whipped cream, chopped peanuts, and a cherry.

 BUSHWACKER 
 
 
 Vanilla milkshake spun with chocolate syrup, Malibu Rum, coffee liqueur topped with whipped cream, chocolate drizzle, and a cherry.
 
 
 
 

 
 BLOODY MARY 
 
 
 Absolut Vodka and bloody Mary mix garnished with celery, lime, and olives.

 SUNLINER MARGARITA 
 
 
 Silver tequila, triple sec, lime juice, and sweet and sour. Served on the rocks.
 
 
 
 

 
 IRISH CREAM COFFEE 
 
 
 Irish Cream, our house-blended coffee, topped with whipped cream, and a sweet treat!

 WINE 
 
 
 

 
 HOUSE RED OR WHITE 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 BEER 
 
 
 

 
 MILLER LITE 
 
 
 
 

 
 CORONA 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 CAKES & PIES

 BIG SLICE OF CAKE

 CHEESECAKE

 Sunliner Diner – Gulf Shores, AL, Pigeon Forge, TN & Orange Beach, AL
 Step Back in Time-Stay for the Sweet Moments

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Hey there, sugar—welcome to Sunliner Diner! 
 We’re so glad you rolled in.
Around here, we believe in slowing things down, turning up the jukebox, and making every meal feel like a celebration.
From chrome booths and creamy milkshakes to breakfast all day and burgers that’ll make your heart sing, we’ve packed a whole lot of joy into every corner of this 1950s dream.
Whether you’re sharing pancakes with your little ones or catching up with old friends over a slice of pie,
Sunliner is all about togetherness, nostalgia, and the kind of comfort that never goes out of style.
So hop in, baby—your table’s ready, the coffee’s hot, and there’s always room for a little more sweetness in your day.

 We’re so happy you’re here.
 The Sunliner Diner Family
